title: I Hope GTA 6 Borrows a Lot From GTA 4
description: GTA6 Hub explores recent gaming media discussions about revisiting Grand Theft Auto 4 and the features fans hope Rockstar will bring to GTA 6.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Revisiting Liberty City: Why GTA 4 Still Matters

Having recently played Grand Theft Auto 4 for the first time since its original release in 2008, many players and critics have begun reflecting on what made the title so special. There is a strong sentiment within the community hoping that Rockstar will borrow heavily from GTA 4 when developing the highly anticipated GTA 6.

While Grand Theft Auto 5 expanded the franchise to unprecedented commercial heights with a massive map and diverse gameplay systems, GTA 4 is often remembered for its groundbreaking physics engine, granular attention to environmental detail, and a grounded atmosphere. These elements have led many long-time fans to advocate for certain classic mechanics to make a triumphant return in the next installment.

## Looking Ahead to GTA 6

As anticipation continues to build for GTA 6, set in the iconic Vice City, discussions regarding what features will carry over from previous titles remain a hot topic. Industry analysis suggests that blending the scale and modernization of GTA 5 with the heavy, realistic physics and immersive world-building of GTA 4 could create the ultimate open-world experience for current-generation hardware.

However, it is important to note that these are community and media-driven hopes rather than confirmed features, as Rockstar has yet to detail every gameplay mechanic for the upcoming title.

## Editor's Take
GTA 4 set a remarkably high bar for physics and environmental immersion back in 2008. If Rockstar can channel that same dedication to detail into GTA 6 while utilizing modern hardware, the upcoming sequel could redefine open-world gaming once again.
